title: Living Ornament batch 1: shape language and first visual
body: F01-F06, initial F15/F16. Expand Organic Regions with stable region contract, mixed lobes/corridors, deep bays, thin necks, localized contour complexity, nesting and fitted boundaries. Expand Organic Boundary Ink with bold/colored double edges; Composition Phrasing and Animated Watercolor with anchors, quiet areas and shape-aware washes. Create separate Living Ornament scene with grouped controls. Parallel lanes: geometry, ink, composition/color after minimal contract agreement. Actual flat-color/outline visual must show substantially different shape families, calm and intricate contour stretches and legible large composition. Artistically inspect and iterate before adding pattern detail. Preserve existing Library behavior. One integrated review, publish compatible component updates, save, commit and merge. First visual uses five or six nodes and can proceed independently of LUX-170. Establish explicit Ornament ABIs before parallel implementation. See docs/visuals/living-ornament-plan.md for three-seed artistic gates.
